fact: WHO's highlights of the 2022-2023 biennium state that WHO supported the Ministry's Department of Health Information Systems in drawing up strategies and micro-plans and strengthening the use of DHIS2 with a data validation component, to overcome shortcomings in the daily recording of health data in district health units and in central, district and regional services.
title: Highlights of the 2022 - 2023 Biennium in São Tomé and Príncipe
publisher: World Health Organization (WHO) Office in São Tomé and Príncipe
